reasons: A 20,000-mile 2020 Carrera S coupe sold on Bring a Trailer for $116,000 on June 22, 2026.
Two more sold there this spring for $117,000 (15,000 miles) and $119,000 (10,000 miles).
This car has 31,775 miles, more than any of those three. The $116,000 car had Sport Chrono and ceramic brakes, and this listing does not show its options.
A certified one in the same green, with 32,047 miles and a 24-month warranty, was listed at $119,955 and has since sold.
The price has already come down from $121,470 on October 28.
pushback: They cite the 34,000-mile car that sold for $124,000. Reply: that was a year ago, and three sales since closed at $116,000 to $119,000.
They say it is priced below market. Reply: below other dealers' asking prices, but above what lower-mile cars actually sold for.
They will not move on price. Ask for the fees to come off or a service to be included, and get the out-the-door number in writing.

summary: Sample from the Nov 14, 2026 research. The three 2026 sales are Bring a Trailer auctions of 2020 Carrera S coupes with PDK: prices, dates and miles as recorded by Classic.com, with VINs, options and auction links from The Classic Valuer. The Cars & Bids search found one 2020 Carrera S coupe, a manual that did not sell in March 2024, so it is left out. Open each link to confirm it before you quote it.
